questions.question: Write 407 052 in words and explain why there is no hundreds word in the second group.
questions.expected_answer: Four hundred and seven thousand and fifty-two. The second group is 052, which has 0 hundreds, so there is no hundreds word and we simply say and fifty-two.

questions.question: Compare 245 318 and 254 138 and write a sentence using greater than or less than.
questions.expected_answer: Both have six digits and both start with 2 hundred thousands. In the ten thousands place 245 318 has 4 and 254 138 has 5, so 254 138 is greater than 245 318, which means 245 318 is less than 254 138.

questions.question: Write 98 765, 102 345 and 99 999 in descending order and explain how you decided.
questions.expected_answer: 102 345, 99 999, 98 765. 102 345 has six digits, so it is the biggest. The other two have five digits and both start with 9, so look at the thousands: 9 beats 8, so 99 999 comes before 98 765.
